comparisons.peer_summary: The company had a net decrease of 145 financial centers and 275 ATMs as it continued to optimize its consumer banking network.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Bank of America disclosed ongoing optimization and reduction of their consumer banking footprints in 2024. Citi reported closing sales in nine of its targeted exit markets and continuing wind-downs in specific countries, focusing on geographic strategic withdrawal. In contrast, Bank of America described a physical network optimization within the U.S., citing a net decrease of 145 financial centers and 275 ATMs to align with shifting banking preferences, rather than exiting entire international markets.

sentences.text: Since announcing its intention to exit consumer banking across 14 markets in Asia, Europe, the Middle East and Mexico as part of its strategic refresh, Citi has now closed sales in nine of those markets, has a sale process underway in Poland and has continued to make progress on its wind-downs in Korea and Russia.
We had a net decrease of 145 financial centers and 275 ATMs as we continued to optimize our consumer banking network.
